title: Renew insurance and coordinate a claim
summary: Before insurance renewal or when a loss may fall within an existing policy. An approved renewal decision or documented claim outcome with coverage, evidence and ongoing actions assigned.
outcomes: An approved renewal decision or documented claim outcome with coverage, evidence and ongoing actions assigned.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: Before insurance renewal or when a loss may fall within an existing policy.

parts.title: Inventory policies and the relevant change or event
parts.guidance: Collect policies, endorsements, insured entities, renewal terms and business changes or loss facts. Preserve evidence and record dates from the actual documents without assuming coverage.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Review coverage and notice requirements with the broker
parts.guidance: The insurance owner and qualified adviser assess exclusions, limits, deductibles, notification and renewal questions. For a claim, verify the insurer channel and obtain advice before admissions or settlements.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Review coverage and notice requirements with the broker

parts.title: Prepare the renewal or claim evidence pack
parts.guidance: For renewal, reconcile exposures, staffing, revenue and requested cover. For a claim, compile the permitted incident, financial and supporting evidence, keeping estimates and confirmed losses separate.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Approve the submission and any commitment
parts.guidance: Authorized people review the disclosures, terms or claim statement before delivery. Approve premiums, settlement terms or mitigation spending separately through their applicable authority.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Approve the submission and any commitment

parts.title: Verify the resulting coverage or claim status
parts.guidance: Retain the issued policy or insurer response, reconcile costs and conditions and assign unresolved information requests. Calendar renewal or claim follow-up and update the company's risk controls.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

verify.how: An approved renewal decision or documented claim outcome with coverage, evidence and ongoing actions assigned.

notes.text: This is an operational coordination guide. Confirm the applicable company facts, contracts and jurisdictions before acting. Qualified advisers own legal, tax, safety or regulatory determinations and any required professional work. The cited authorities describe their named jurisdictions or frameworks; their rules are not asserted for other countries. External actions require approval for the specific action.
Editorial status: operational draft. Source pages checked on 2026-10-29. No case-specific legal review, professional assurance or completed execution is claimed.
